scope: Proposition 13.7 (Column and layer transport) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 65. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Si, Ti be finite rational planar rectangle families of positive side lengths, each separately disjoint, with endpoints on the B−2 grid, where B ≥ 2 is an integer. Let their assigned center-to-center positive reciprocal diagonal affine maps satisfy Fi(Si) = Ti. A finite effective solenoidal field in R3 realizes all these maps on the rectangles in z = 0. Along each tracked path the first coordinate stays between its initial and final values. The field has compact support and flat time collars.
